the frequencies of CD11b-positive and CD32-positive cells from the whole blood are elevated in patients with AODS compared to patients with RA and healthy controls.

the expression of CD11b is significantly higher on mononuclear cells from patients with AOSDs compared to RA and HC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CD11b and the CD32 are highly expressed on peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with AOSDs.

AOSD patients had higher frequencies of CD11b-positive and CD32-positive cells in their whole blood than patients with RA or healthy controls, which suggests that these receptors may play a role in the pathogenesis of this disease.
AOSD is characterized by the presence of a high number of CD11b-positive monocytes and granulocytes in peripheral blood.
